entries.en:
P'obyano requires an adventurer to aid in the fireworks festivities of the Moonfire Faire.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.

* Cette quête est un événement à durée limitée.

P'obyano a besoin de vous pour allumer des feux d'artifice aménagés sur l'eau.

entries.en:
P'obyano asks that you help light fireworks for the Moonfire Faire. Use the summer firework at three firework mortars located in the vicinity of the Isle of Endless Summer.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: You took word of your deeds back to P'obyano. Speak to her again if you wish to help further with the Moonfire Faire fireworks.
entries.fr: P'obyano vous a chaleureusement remercié<if(gnum4,e,)> pour votre aide. Retournez la voir si l'envie vous vient d'allumer d'autres feux d'artifice.
entries.ja: ペ・オビヤノに報告した。気が向いたら、また彼女に声をかけて、海上花火の催しを手伝うのもよいだろう。

entries.en: Back for more, are you? I'll not turn away an offer to help. Would you see fit to light some more fireworks for us?

あら、, ,1)>さん！
また協力してくれるのね。
それじゃ、今回も花火の点火をお願いできる？

この「」を投入してちょうだい。
